title: Warsim native family map: all systems, helpers, tables and parent-gap records

reviews.classification: full actual native-map content review through exact lossless factoring
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual content review covers all12356JSON lines through the exactly reconstructable factored reading view: header/14families, all16routing blocks, all prior/mapping/remaining/limit dictionaries, I01–I32, H001–H143, T001–T255, BASE-U1–U11, REA-U1–U8, ASPECT-U1–U9 and G01/G02. Every field, including native address/byte-size, source locator, changed evidence, mutable exclusions and parent-gap resolution, was read in bounded output. The [lossless receipt](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/warsim-family-view-receipt-b590.json) proves reconstruction equality and unchanged source SHA64fe203f90d857f11459f16b6677d304cfb3db8f77b3a07d0d82db2310fcabca; the [reading view](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/warsim-family-lossless-view-b590.json) retains original values by reference. JSON schema/bytes remain untouched. This reads the map, not any private native body/payload or present installed game.

F2:32systems+143helpers+255tables+28prior-gap rows+2owner notes are460records of different kinds, not460mechanics. System statuses26partial/5named-only/1partial-static, helper95named-only/27partial/20partial-static/1retained-selected, and table92unread/98schema-partial/27excluded-mutable/38static-text-read each sum their respective input class. All255table paths exactly match the earlier TABLE_COVERAGE path set; row status differs because the later map records selected source extensions and exclusions. Same path/count does not mean equivalent semantic review, independent source breadth or current payload parity.

F3: I01–I32 preserve kingdom/race/name/portrait/story, contextual talk/advice/entertainment, petitions/exploration/quest, clock/economy/recruitment/combat/arena/monster, relation/diplomacy/council/community, local market/contest/character, ceremony/menu/UI/audio, save/Extras/endings questions. Numeric row/slot/form/writer counts are source-specific inventory signals.14×15relation values differ from196random cells; this can include fixed fields, not an automatic contradiction.1903writer fields versus1454numeric joins leave449string joins explicitly open. A scratch quest tuple or one value-to-gold caller is not a durable objective journal or general story transaction. A retained generated biography/name is not a simulated past.

F4: H001–H143 use byte span to the next symbol, not exact semantic function size or complete code coverage. Partial static paths and per-helper evidence cannot certify all callers, frame/ABI interpretation, modifier order, phase cadence, save/RNG lifecycle or broad battle/market rules. Address pins belong to their build/source snapshot; older REA locators cannot be substituted by matching a name. Named graphical/console/menu/audio helpers and class labels do not establish rendered accessibility, policy or effect. A retained GameOver export inspected only for one late DiceGameType6 route does not close endings/afterlife/meta loops. G01/G02 correctly retain an existing broad life/presentation owner with an unlocated rule leaf, not no-owner proof or a reason to add a separate framework.

F5: T001–T255 preserve static talk/name/race/weapon/art/filter/credit tables versus mutable relations, companion/nobility/adventurer/portrait/naming-system files and settings excluded from capture. Their presence in a map is not permission to read personal state. The38Extras rows retain prior_metadata_only=true/private_capture_available=false alongside new_private_capture locators and later static_text_read_runtime_link_unread status. Treat old availability flags as retained provenance, not as overriding the later specific capture or proving current availability. All38static reference reads remain attributed prior work, not B590 raw-source reads. Art/concepts/cheat lists do not establish current native compatibility, live rendering or complete feature semantics.

F6: All28parent-gap rows remain retained-open or partly-extended-parent-still-open. S01relations mutation does not establish opponent AI/truce enforcement; S02/S03/S04roster identity writers do not complete companion/string/load isolation; S06/S07feed/reset/HP/ability joins do not cover all activities; S08value-to-gold is not a quest journal; S12/S15local dispatch/refresh does not finish annual cadence, event matrices, budgets or away behavior. Early timeouts and missing jump-table/ABI limitations remain visible. Gameplay and private state are deliberate exclusions, not tasks to revive from a quoted old follow-up. Current PROJECT and AD36/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52 govern selected reuse; the old P01 priority, broad inferred packet routing and source rarity/cost/cap are not new product authority. No source extraction, execution, private data, native UI, test/build/browser, worker, migration, acquisition, deletion, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: All460records plus16routing blocks/header/dictionaries read in bounded lossless output. Source SHA and parsed reconstruction equality recorded;255-path set equals older TABLE_COVERAGE. Underlying source/payload/runtime not read by proxy.
reviews.reopen: Choose a precise rule consumer/current source/build to reopen a parent gap; retain mutable/private exclusions.
